name: Prune orphaned files
info:
Deletes files from /data/bridge-files/files/ that belong to connections that no longer exist.

### Input
Any message (trigger). Typically from:
- Container startup (inject once)
- New connection creation

### Output
`msg.payload` = summary string: '3 files pruned, 12 files retained'

### Behavior
- Lists all files in /data/bridge-files/files/
- Parses connection_name from each filename (format: {msg_id}---{conn_name}---{filename})
- Checks if that connection_name exists in parat_bridge.connections
- Deletes files whose connection no longer exists
- Files for active connections are retained for post-exercise review

### File naming convention
`{message_id}---{connection_name}---{original_filename}`
The triple-dash separator allows reliable parsing even when
original filenames contain underscores or single dashes.
